Subject: dark matter | ID: 69284

Theorem

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|U_{01300013}|^p) \leq C_01300013\) follows from the torsion-free Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the real convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
